description: Search the register of Australian Registered Training Organisations (RTOs, the providers that issue VET qualifications such as Certificate III/IV and Diplomas) by name, trading name, RTO code, ABN or linked school name, with filters for state, registration status (current / historical), regulatory decisions in effect and providers with courses on oneuedu.com. Each result gives registration status and period, regulator, decision counts, the CRICOS schools linked to the RTO, and the oneuedu.com and training.gov.au links. Use get_rto for one RTO in full. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

query.description: Legal or trading name, RTO code, ABN, or the name of a CRICOS school linked to the RTO (e.g. "Kingston", "22134", "TAFE NSW").

sort.description: name (default; an exact RTO code match comes first), recentlyEnded (latest registration end first; default for status historical), oneuCourses (most courses open on oneuedu.com first).

state.description: State or territory of the head office.

status.description: current (default) = registration in effect; historical = cancelled, revoked, surrendered or lapsed; all = both.

withCurrentRegulatoryDecisions.description: Only RTOs with a regulatory decision currently in effect or under review (conditions, suspension, cancellation, etc.).

withOneuCourses.description: Only RTOs linked to a CRICOS school with courses open for application on oneuedu.com (not with status historical).

name: search_rtos
title: Search Australian RTOs (vocational training providers)
